body:
Part of #98.

## Why

`serveContexts` runs once, while the server boots (`src/serve.js:128`, called from `startServer` at
:317). #96 documented the consequence — a change to the board list needs `hkb serve` restarted. Once
`hkb init` registers checkouts automatically, that restart is the last manual step left: set up a repo
while the server is up and it still will not appear. Fixing registration without this one just trades
"edit a JSON file" for "bounce the server".

## What

Make the served board set live.

- Re-resolve the user-level list on a cadence — once per poll interval is right, and it costs no
  GitHub call: `loadUserBoards` is a local file read.
- A board that appeared gets added and starts being polled. A board that vanished from the list stops
  being served and its cache is dropped.
- **Boards that are still in the list keep their existing state** — their `boardState` closure, cached
  cards, `generation` counter and detail cache. A reload must never blank a working board or force a
  refetch of everything; that is the difference between this and just restarting.
- Log a one-liner when the set actually changes. A stale entry already logs "skipping …" — make sure it
  logs once when it appears, not on every poll forever.
- `boards`, `byKey` and `keyList()` at src/serve.js:317-319 are `const` and captured by every handler.
  They have to become re-derivable without tearing the handlers off their bindings.

## Done when

`npm run lint && npm test` is green and `test/serve.test.js` covers, using the existing temp
`KB_CONFIG_HOME` harness at test/serve.test.js:157:

- a board added to `boards.json` after the server started is served, without a restart;
- a board removed from the list stops being served;
- a board present before and after a reload keeps its cached cards (assert no refetch);
- a stale entry is logged once across several reloads, not once per poll;
- `--repos` is unaffected: an explicit set does not reload.

## Contract

- **`--repos` stays static.** It is an explicit set the human typed for this run; only the user-level
  list is live. `serveContexts`' existing "explicit wins" behaviour must not change.
- Keep board identity coming from `keyBoards` — stable `key` per `repo#board` is what makes preserving
  a board's cache across a reload possible. Do not renumber or re-key boards on reload.
- Touch only `src/serve.js` and `test/serve.test.js`. Do not change `loadUserBoards`, `expandHome` or
  `userBoardsFile` in `src/board.js` — a sibling is adding a writer next to them.
goal: a board added to the list appears on a running hkb serve without a restart
title: hkb serve picks up boards.json changes while it runs
